metadata.scenario: A small business owner calls to contest charges on their monthly service bill that do not match the agreement. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Karen Lewis. I'm calling about a billing issue I noticed on my latest statement. I'm glad you called, Karen. What seems to be the issue with your bill? It looks like there are charges for services that we didn’t agree on when we started. I understand. Can you specify which charges you're referring to? Yes, there are extra fees for personal care assistance that we never discussed. I see. Let me pull up your account details to check the charges. One moment, please. Okay, I have your account here. It looks like there were additional hours billed for personal care services that weren’t in our initial agreement. Can you tell me when these services were rendered? The charges are from the last two weeks, but we only agreed to a certain number of hours. Thank you for clarifying that. I apologize for any confusion. Let’s go over the agreement you had with us. Yes, please. I want to ensure I’m only paying for what we agreed upon. Absolutely. I see here that you were scheduled for 10 hours of personal care assistance per week. Right, and I only received that amount. So why are there extra charges? It appears there was a miscommunication about the actual hours worked. Let me resolve that for you. That would be great. I don't want to be overcharged. I completely understand your concern, Karen. I will investigate this and ensure any incorrect charges are removed. Thank you, I appreciate that. How long will this take? I’ll need to follow up with our billing department. I can call you back in 24 to 48 hours with an update. That sounds good. Can I also ask if you have post-operative care services available for my husband? Yes, we do offer post-surgery recovery care. It includes specialized care for clients recovering from surgical procedures. What are the costs associated with that service? The price ranges from $85 to $110 per session, depending on the level of care needed. That sounds reasonable. I might want to schedule that after I confirm the billing issue. Of course! I’ll make a note to follow up with you about scheduling once we resolve your billing concerns. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help with all of this. You're welcome, Karen! I’ll be in touch soon. Have a great day! You too! Bye. Bye!
